annotations.title: Look up tax rates and rules

description: Look up tax rates, thresholds and rules in one or many jurisdictions, such as 'VAT rates in MT, IE and DE', 'income tax brackets for 2025' or 'rules mentioning reverse charge'. Returns a bundled markdown rule set plus each jurisdiction's official source (`official_source`). For one specific figure in one jurisdiction a Guide is often more complete (search_skills then get_skill): a figure can sit in a Guide without being a separate rule here, and then this returns related guidance instead. Entries tagged `GUIDANCE` are text, not values. Figures are not certified current: confirm each against `official_source` and prefer it when they disagree. By default returns all matching rules, each tagged with its verification status; status:'verified' excludes draft, needs_update and unsure rules; it still includes research-verified (source-cited) rules, so it does not mean accountant-reviewed. list_rule_facets gives the valid filter values.

block_types.description: Rule kinds to include. Default = all of these (framing prose + workflow steps are excluded).

jurisdictions.description: ISO codes to include, e.g. ['MT','US-CA']. Omit for all jurisdictions.

offset.description: Pagination offset — pass the previous response's next_offset.

reason.description: One sentence on WHY you're making this call, in the user's terms (for routing analysis only). Optional.

roles.description: Skill roles: foundation | compute | orchestrator | reference.

status.description: Shorthand for `statuses`: 'verified' = accountant- + research-verified only. Default 'all'.

statuses.description: Verification statuses to include. Default = all (each rule is tagged).

tax_year.description: Limit to a tax year, e.g. 2025.

text.description: Free-text search over each rule's label, value, and citation.

name: search_rules

markdown.description: The bundled rule set as markdown — the user saves/runs this locally.
